units.source_text: 六条妃子在枕畔设置源氏公子的座位，

en.t: Lady Rokujo had a seat prepared for Prince Genji beside her pillow,

units.source_text: 自己坐起身来靠在矮几上，

en.t: then sat up herself and leaned against a low armrest,

units.source_text: 隔着帷屏与公子谈话。

en.t: and spoke with the prince from behind the curtain screen.

units.source_text: 源氏公子推察她身体已经十分衰弱，

en.t: Prince Genji perceived that her body had grown terribly weak,

units.source_text: 想道：“自昔至今，我始终怜爱她。

en.t: and thought, "From long ago until now, I have always loved and pitied her.

units.source_text: 此心尚未向她表白，

en.t: I have still not revealed these feelings to her,

units.source_text: 难道就此诀别了么？”

en.t: and can this truly be our final parting?"

units.source_text: 痛惜之下，伤心地哭泣起来。

en.t: Overcome with grief and regret, he began to weep sorrowfully.

units.source_text: 六条妃子看见公子对她如此多情，

en.t: Seeing that the prince felt such deep affection for her,

units.source_text: 心中万分感动，

en.t: Lady Rokujo was profoundly moved in her heart,

units.source_text: 便把女儿前斋宫向他托付：“我死之后，此女定然孤苦。

en.t: and entrusted her daughter, the former Ise Priestess, to him, saying, "After I die, this child will surely be lonely and helpless.

units.source_text: 务请将她放在心上，

en.t: Please keep her in your thoughts,

units.source_text: 凡遇事故，勿忘照拂。

en.t: and whenever something happens, do not forget to care for her.

units.source_text: 因为她别无保护者，身世异常不幸也。

en.t: She has no other protector, and her circumstances are unusually unfortunate.

units.source_text: 我身虽一女流，但教一息尚存，

en.t: Though I am only a woman, as long as a breath remains in me,

units.source_text: 总想悉心抚育，直到她知情达理之年……”

en.t: I have always wished to raise her with all my care until she reaches an age of understanding..."

units.source_text: 说到这里，泣不成声，仿佛命在须臾了。

en.t: At this point she broke down in tears, unable to speak, as if her life might end at any moment.

units.source_text: 源氏公子答道：“即使你不叮嘱，我也决无遗忘之理。

en.t: Prince Genji replied, "Even if you had not asked me, there is no possibility that I would forget her.

units.source_text: 今既承嘱，自当尽心竭力，多方照顾。

en.t: Now that I have received your request, I will naturally devote all my heart and strength to caring for her in every way.

units.source_text: 务请勿以后事为念。”

en.t: Please do not worry about what will happen after you are gone."

units.source_text: 六条妃子说：“如此说来，多多有劳了！

en.t: Lady Rokujo said, "If that is so, I must trouble you greatly.

units.source_text: 但她即使有个确实可靠的父亲悉心照顾，

en.t: Yet even if she had a truly dependable father to care for her with all his heart,

units.source_text: 无母之女，总是最可怜的。

en.t: a motherless daughter is always the most pitiful of all.

units.source_text: 不过，你倘过分爱怜，将她列入恋侣，

en.t: However, if you love and pity her too much and count her among your lovers,

units.source_text: 则深恐引人妒忌，反遭意外之殃。

en.t: I deeply fear it will invite others' jealousy and instead bring her some unexpected misfortune.

units.source_text: 此虽我之过虑，但请决勿妄动此念。

en.t: This may be needless worry on my part, but please never entertain such a thought.

units.source_text: 我有亲身经历，痛感女子身罹情网，

en.t: From my own experience, I know painfully well what it means for a woman to become entangled in the net of love,

units.source_text: 必多意外之苦。

en.t: and that it inevitably brings many unexpected sufferings.

units.source_text: 故我决心要她摒绝情思，以处女终其身。”

en.t: Therefore I have resolved that she should renounce all thoughts of love and end her life as a maiden."

units.source_text: 源氏公子听了，觉得这话说得好直率！

en.t: Hearing this, Prince Genji thought how very direct her words were.

units.source_text: 便答道：“年来我已备尝酸楚，深通世故。

en.t: He answered, "Over the years I have tasted much bitterness and come to understand the ways of the world deeply.

units.source_text: 你还以为我像昔年一样易动好色之情么？

en.t: Do you still think I am as easily moved by amorous desires as I was in former days?

units.source_text: 此真乃出我意外！

en.t: That truly surprises me.

units.source_text: 罢了罢了，我今不必多说，日久自见人心。”

en.t: Enough, enough. I need say no more now; in time, a person's heart will reveal itself."
